description_en: Configures whether the operation buttons, such as Agree, Revoke, and Sign, are displayed in the ticket approval section of the DMS console
description_zh: 调用此API可以设置DMS工单审批区域是否需要显示同意、撤销、加签等按钮
name: SetWorkflowExtraInfo

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

To view the ID of the tenant, go to the DMS console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html section of the "Manage DMS tenants" topic
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The link of approval workflow for third parties
parameters.name: thirdparty_workflow_url

parameters.help_en: The remarks of approval workflow for third parties
parameters.name: thirdparty_workflow_comment

parameters.help_en: The ID of the approval workflow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144642.html operation to query the ID of the approval workflow
parameters.help_zh: 审批流ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144642.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: workflow_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the Agree button is displayed in the ticket approval section of the DMS console for a third-party approval workflow. Valid values:

true (default): The Agree button is displayed.
false: The Agree button is not displayed
parameters.help_zh:
使用第三方审批流程审批工单时，是否需要在DMS工单审批区域显示同意审批的按钮。取值如下：

true（默认）：表示当DMS界面会显示同意按钮。

false：表示DMS工单审批区域不会出现同意按钮
parameters.name: render_agree
